name: DeleteAllBlobsFromContainer
label: Delete All Blobs from Container
description: Deletes all blobs in the specified Azure Blob container. Returns the number of successfully deleted blobs.

fields.name: BlobContainerClient
fields.label: Blob Container Client
fields.description: The BlobContainerClient instance used to access and delete all blobs in the container.

fields.name: BlobsDeletedCount
fields.label: Blobs Deleted Count
fields.description: The number of blobs successfully deleted from the container.
